title: Data-Efficient Classifier Pretraining Through Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23289v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning with limited data is susceptible to overfitting, especially with modern deep neural networks. Prior to the introduction of AlexNet, reconstruction-based pretraining with auto-encoder and denoising auto-encoder were found to be beneficial, partially due to the limited size of the training sets at the time. Motivated by these traditional approaches, we propose DiffPT, a simple diffusion modeling approach to pretrain a given classifier backbone for limited domain-specific training data. We experiment on time-series data, standard natural-image benchmarks, and medical imaging datasets, and contrast the diffusion approach to a multitude of modern and traditional un/self-supervised methods. translated_title: 通过扩散模型实现数据高效的分类器预训练
translated_abstract: 在数据有限的机器学习任务中，模型容易过拟合，尤其是现代深度神经网络。在AlexNet出现之前，基于重构的预训练方法（如自编码器和去噪自编码器）被证明是有益的，这部分归因于当时训练集规模有限。受这些传统方法的启发，我们提出了DiffPT，这是一种简单的扩散建模方法，用于在特定领域训练数据有限的情况下预训练给定的分类器骨干网络。我们在时间序列数据、标准自然图像基准以及医学影像数据集上进行实验，并将该扩散方法与现代和传统的多种无/自监督方法进行对比。尽管在低数据量场景下，对比学习预训练在CIFAR-10和Tiny ImageNet上表现更好，但DiffPT在医学影像和时间序列任务上尤为有效，在一系列低数据量场景中其性能超越了自监督基线方法。
tldr: 提出DiffPT扩散建模预训练方法，可在领域训练数据有限时有效预训练分类器骨干网络，并在医学影像和时间序列任务中超越自监督基线方法。
en_tdlr: DiffPT, a simple diffusion-modeling pretraining approach, effectively pretrains classifier backbones with limited domain-specific data and outperforms self-supervised baselines on medical imaging and time-series tasks.
